messages: Tip: You can choose video and audio quality separately before downloading.
Tip: Use Audio only when you just need the soundtrack.
Tip: YouLoad keeps your recent activity so you can find downloads again quickly.
Tip: You can cancel an active download at any time.
Tip: Queue multiple videos and let YouLoad handle them one after another.
Tip: Choose your download folder before starting a download.
Fact: YouLoad uses yt-dlp to handle video extraction.
Fact: FFmpeg is used when YouLoad needs to merge or process media streams.
Tip: Higher video quality usually means a larger download.
Tip: For smaller files, choose a lower video resolution and audio quality.
Fact: YouLoad is made by NISPAX InfoTech.
Tip: You can open the original video directly from Recent Activity.
Tip: If a video has separate video and audio streams, YouLoad can combine them for you.
Tip: Keep YouLoad updated from Settings to get the latest downloader and runtime fixes.
Tip: Check the Queue page to see downloads waiting to start.
